info.name: UPS Forwarding
info.description:
UPS Forwarding allows users to create and manage freight forwarding shipments—including Air, Ocean, and Ground—via API as a shipper, receiver, or third-party bill-to account.

Visit the full [UPS Forwarding Documentation](https://developer.ups.com/tag/Forwarding) for more details!
